description: For competitive ad research: finds the Google Ads advertiser accounts that match 1-5 company or brand names in the Google Ads Transparency Center. Returns advertiser name, advertiser ID, verification status, advertiser country, approximate number of ads and related domains (the IDs and domains also work as google_advertiser_ads targets). Billed per advertiser account returned.

max_per_name.description: Advertiser accounts to return per name (default 5).

names.description: 1-5 company or brand names, e.g. hubspot, notion.

region.description: Where the ads were shown: country code (US, DE), country name, or "anywhere" (default US).

name: find_google_advertisers
title: Find Google advertiser accounts
